desc: When beaches close and days get short, BJJ keeps Cape Codders active, social, and motivated all winter.

Beat the Cape Cod Winter Slump With Jiu-Jitsu

August 31, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

Cape Cod winters are quiet. Summer crowds disappear, days are short, and it's tempting to hibernate until spring.

Stay active indoors

Jiu-jitsu gives you a warm, energetic place to train no matter what the weather is doing on Route 132.

Fight the winter blues

Regular exercise and social connection can make the darker months feel a lot brighter.

Build a routine

Off-season is the perfect time to commit to something new before summer gets busy again.

Come back in shape for summer

Train through winter and you'll hit the beach in better shape than ever.

Make this winter different. Visit Cristyan Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy in Hyannis.

Train with us in Hyannis

Visit us at 1513 Iyannough Rd, Hyannis MA 02601 or call (508) 364-7697.
